headline: Good morning — Nvidia's leadership shock dragged Wall Street's tech stocks lower, while Australian home values and auction results keep sliding.

highlights.label: Nvidia shock
highlights.text: Nvidia fell below US$4 trillion in market value after CEO Jensen Huang's exit, pulling the Nasdaq down 0.91% on Friday.

highlights.label: Property slump
highlights.text: Cotality reported national home values fell 1.2% in October, the seventh straight monthly decline, with auction clearance rates still weak.

highlights.label: Kia in Andhra
highlights.text: Kia India announced a roughly US$2 billion new plant in Andhra Pradesh at the Visakhapatnam investment summit.

tip.title: Give your eyes a 20-20-20 break
tip.body: Every 20 minutes of screen work, look at something about 20 feet (6 metres) away for around 20 seconds. It is a simple way to ease eye strain and doubles as a prompt to loosen your shoulders and neck. Pair it with a sip of water to make it stick.

quote.text: You must do the thing you think you cannot do.
quote.author: Eleanor Roosevelt

items.title: Salesforce–Braze deal reshapes the engagement market
items.summary: Analysis of Salesforce's agreement to buy Braze looks at what it means for email and customer engagement platforms as vendors consolidate the messaging layer. The deal is not yet closed, so marketers should watch how Marketing Cloud and Braze roadmaps are combined.

items.title: Weekly martech roundup: Adobe, Sprout Social, TrueDialog
items.summary: The weekly digest collects product updates from several martech vendors including Adobe, Sprout Social and TrueDialog. It is a quick way to catch the week's launches in one place.

items.title: Microsoft 365 outage disrupts HubSpot's Outlook tools
items.summary: A Microsoft 365 outage on 12 November partly disrupted the Outlook inbox and calendar features in HubSpot's sales tools. Teams relying on email-sync logging may see gaps in activity records.

items.title: Email deliverability enforcement keeps tightening
items.summary: The vendor analysis says Gmail's sender thresholds are unchanged since 2024 but enforcement has moved from filtering to outright SMTP rejections. It also flags new reverse DNS and HELO expectations; this is a vendor blog and not independently confirmed.

items.title: Latest AI-powered martech releases
items.summary: MarTech's running list tracks new AI features from marketing platforms, including agentic tools from vendors such as Adobe. It helps marketers see which AI capabilities are shipping rather than just announced.

items.title: Salesforce to buy Braze in roughly US$5.7 billion deal
items.summary: Salesforce agreed in late October to acquire Braze, reported at about US$5.66 billion in enterprise value, with closing expected in its fiscal 2028. It targets Marketing Cloud's real-time engagement gap.

items.title: Salesforce plans to acquire voice AI firm Cresta
items.summary: Salesforce announced on 2 November that it will buy Cresta, with completion expected in the first quarter of fiscal 2028 subject to regulatory approval. It strengthens the company's voice AI offering for service teams.

items.title: Agentforce Coworker expands to Teams, mobile and desktop
items.summary: Agentforce Coworker is reported to be arriving in Microsoft Teams, on iOS and as a desktop app this month. Details come from a secondary outlet and should be confirmed on Salesforce's newsroom.

items.title: Salesforce sets 2 December date for Q3 earnings
items.summary: Salesforce will release fiscal third-quarter 2027 results on Wednesday 2 December 2026 after the US market close. That is early Thursday 3 December in Melbourne.

items.title: Dreamforce 2026 announcements recap
items.summary: Salesforce Ben summarises the biggest launches from Dreamforce 2026. Several are slated to reach general availability this month, so admins should check release timing.

sfstatus.statusNote: A Marketing Cloud feature disruption on Australian instances was listed as ongoing at last update on 10 November; check status.salesforce.com for the latest.

items.title: Marketing Cloud email content stuck publishing on AU instances
items.summary: A feature disruption affects Marketing Cloud Growth and Advanced editions on several Australian instances, with a fix deployed to most and the rest expected by 12 November. The page was last updated 10 November, so current status is unconfirmed.

items.title: Marketing Cloud Next setup issue resolved
items.summary: Customers could not select a data space, blocking Marketing Cloud Next provisioning, until Salesforce reverted a configuration change on 2 November. It is resolved but is outside the 48-hour window.

items.title: Analysis: Albanese government seen as floundering
items.summary: An ABC analysis argues the government is struggling amid poor polling and a grants controversy. Albanese has insisted the government remains united and that Jim Chalmers stays as Treasurer.

items.title: Backlash over $3 billion Microsoft contracts after outage
items.summary: Critics are questioning single-vendor IT contracts worth about $3 billion after a global outage reportedly locked nearly 200,000 public servants out of email on Friday. It renews scrutiny of government technology procurement.

items.title: Albanese heads to COP31 in Turkey amid political noise
items.summary: The Prime Minister is travelling to the COP31 climate summit while leaks and Treasury tensions dominate domestic coverage. Critics also question the cost of Australia's summit preparations.

items.title: Victorian budget update cuts growth forecast ahead of election
items.summary: The update lowers Victoria's growth forecast to 1% and lifts expected unemployment to 5.25%, with Treasury citing weaker population growth and rate rises. The state election is on 28 November.

items.title: RBA lifts cash rate to 4.85%, an 18-year high
items.summary: The RBA raised the cash rate on 3 November, saying the economy is slowing and unemployment has risen. This story is older than 48 hours but remains the main driver of borrowers' costs.

items.title: Retail inflation reported above RBI's tolerance band
items.summary: A digest of The Hindu's 13 November edition cites October retail inflation of 6.1%, above the RBI's upper limit. Not independently confirmed against official data.

items.title: Government weighs special Parliament session on delimitation
items.summary: The same digest reports the government is considering a special session to pass a delimitation Bill. Details are from a headline list and not confirmed.

items.title: India–Bangladesh talks postponed over Hasina issue
items.summary: Bilateral talks were reported postponed amid a rift linked to former Bangladesh leader Sheikh Hasina. Earlier reporting said India could give no timeline on her extradition request.

items.title: NHRC raises concerns over Meta funding to UNICEF
items.summary: The rights commission featured in the day's headlines over Meta's funding to UNICEF. Only the headline was available, so details are unconfirmed.

items.title: Supreme Court stays UGC Equity Regulations 2026
items.summary: The Supreme Court is listed as staying implementation of the UGC Equity Regulations, 2026. The date is unclear, so this may be older than 48 hours.

items.title: Kia India to invest about US$2 billion in Andhra Pradesh
items.summary: Kia India announced a new manufacturing plant in the state at the CII Partnership Summit in Visakhapatnam. Job and capacity figures come from a single outlet and are unconfirmed.

items.title: Summit day one yields Rs 5.84 lakh crore in pledges
items.summary: The state reported 88 agreements and orders on the opening day with potential for about 1.08 lakh jobs. These are preliminary tallies and may change.

items.title: Reliance and Greenko among major summit investors
items.summary: Reliance is reported as the largest named investor with a proposed Rs 2.73 lakh crore in East Godavari. Greenko also signed on among 73 MoUs.

items.title: Cabinet approves AVGC-XR, robotics policies and big investments
items.summary: The 10 November cabinet cleared new animation and gaming and robotics and physical AI policies, plus a 512 MW AI data centre near Visakhapatnam. It also approved a battery materials plant at Naidupeta.

items.title: Naidu's Tamil Nadu remark sparks investment rivalry
items.summary: Chief Minister Naidu's 'masala versus results' comment drew a response from Tamil Nadu's TVK, which challenged Andhra to compare records on investment and jobs. It shows growing competition between the southern states for industry.

items.title: Wall Street ends lower as Nvidia drama weighs on tech
items.summary: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq slipped on Friday while the Dow edged up. Despite the fall, the S&P 500 gained about 2.5% for the week.

items.title: Nvidia drops below US$4 trillion market value
items.summary: Nvidia closed under US$4 trillion for the first time since July 2025 after CEO Jensen Huang's departure. CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO.

items.title: Huang announces resignation as Nvidia CEO
items.summary: Nvidia shares fell more than 4% on Thursday after Huang stepped down as CEO and director. Reports linked the exit to personal conduct matters, and accounts of the circumstances vary.

items.title: Nvidia earnings on 17 November are next test
items.summary: Analysts have downgraded the stock after the leadership shake-up, though many still rate it a buy. The earnings report on 17 November is the next catalyst.

items.title: Wholesale inflation near four-year annual high
items.summary: One market recap says producer prices cooled on the month but reached a near four-year high annually, adding to caution. Not independently confirmed here.

items.title: ASX falls as materials and property retreat
items.summary: The ASX 200 fell 64.6 points on Friday, with eight of 11 sectors lower and materials down 1.61%. It still gained about 0.68% over the week.

items.title: Five things to watch on the ASX 200
items.summary: The preview noted the index had slipped almost 0.1% to 9,146.8 on Thursday. It outlines the movers investors were watching going into Friday.

items.title: RBA hikes cash rate to 4.85%
items.summary: The 3 November increase to an 18-year high keeps rate-sensitive sectors under pressure. This is older than 48 hours but remains the key backdrop for the market.

items.title: ASX daily market briefing for 13 November
items.summary: A daily briefing covers Friday's session. No AUD/USD rate or ASX futures figure was found, and no major data is confirmed for today.

items.title: Home values fall for seventh straight month
items.summary: Cotality data showed national dwelling values fell 1.2% in October, putting the index about 6.7% below its March peak. The ABC framed it as a potential largest downturn in 40 years; this is older than 48 hours.

items.title: Capital city auction results for 8–14 November
items.summary: Preliminary Domain figures show Melbourne at 58%, Sydney 44%, Adelaide 39% and Brisbane just 17%. Final numbers may differ.

items.title: Auction clearance rates at lowest in six years
items.summary: Domain reports clearance rates plunging to a six-year low as buyers hold back. The article's date is not confirmed.

items.title: Sydney home values fell 1.6% in October
items.summary: Sydney dropped 1.6% in October, with Brisbane down 2% and Perth 1.7%. Figures are from Cotality's October index.

items.title: Weekly Australian property market update
items.summary: A running market update tracks auction volumes and prices across the capitals. Earlier weekly data put the national clearance rate at 45.6%, well below last year's 67.7%.
